criteria.text: Uses the agent-local base URL (not serverConfigService.url).
criteria.reason: Verified statically: OrgProposalsDataSource hard-codes AppConstants.agentLocalBaseUrl in its constructor and takes no serverConfigService/baseUrl parameter, matching agent_webhooks_data_source.dart's pattern. Confirmed by code review of the constructor, not a runtime test — the fake-data-source UI tests never exercise the real HTTP call, so a network-level assertion of the URL would not add coverage beyond re-reading the same literal.
